ticket: BLD-05 (bundle B4 of plans/q2_dag.json); CAP-07, CAP-08, TGT-12, TGT-18 (proposed)
kernel: The data-only kernel is the frozen B1 version (plans/b1_freeze.json: code hash and rule); B2-B4 use it unchanged. Thresholds below are fixed before any B2-B4 run, dev or held-out.
stability: B = 10 row resamples with replacement (seed 20261015); the frozen kernel rebuilt on each; a DV-1 claim's stability is the share of resamples making the same claim; a directed claim's is the share giving the same arrow
files: replicate rep000 of every scenario (1 per scenario: 25 files per family and split). Changed on 2026-10-15 before any B4 run (dev or held-out) from 'rep000 and rep001' to halve the compute (10 kernel rebuilds per file); recorded here.
map: isotonic regression (pool-adjacent-violators) of correctness on stability, one map per family and claim kind, fitted on all dev files, frozen with sha256 in plans/b4_freeze.json before any held-out read; dev quality reported out of fold (5 folds by scenario)

selective_view.half_coverage: claims kept in order of calibrated probability (ties together) until at least half of all target-outcome pairs are covered

gates.B4.1: within-family ECE of calibrated DV-1 claims on held-out files <= 0.05 (as hashed)
gates.B4.2: realised precision >= claimed - 0.03 at c/g = 1, 2, 4 (as hashed)

landmark.ER-2: DV-1 precision > 0.80 at coverage >= 0.50 in both families, lower end of the scenario-cluster 95% interval

predictions.Q-B4a: top-50%-coverage selective view > 0.78 precise on dev, out of fold (refuted: < 0.72)

held_out_reads: kernel/run_b4.py refuses the test split unless code and maps equal plans/b4_freeze.json; logged in analysis/results/q2_b4/access_log.jsonl
